The '''Long Exile''' is the name given to the period when the [[Ogier]] lost track of the ''[[stedding]]'' and began to succumb to the sickness of the [[Longing]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Long Exile, the}}{{ref|{{twotc}}, Wandering, the Long}} This period spans much of the [[Breaking of the World]] and some of the succeeding generations before the Ogier found the ''stedding'' again.

Despite the 3,500 years that have passed since the Exile, the Ogier still suffer from the Longing if they spend more than a few years outside the ''stedding'' without returning. The Ogier of [[Seanchan]] did not suffer from the Exile, as they never lost track of the ''stedding'', which were more numerous on their landmass.
